quotes.text: You leave your drink around me, believe your drank going to get drunk up.

senses.definition: (obsolete or informal) past participle of drink
examples: He'd drank alcohol prior to driving off the road.

quotes.text: Tho’ the Barber had drank down this Story with greedy Ears, he was not yet ſatisfied.
